sample.headerRow.description: Makes the first row of the data bold with a fill and a bottom border, and freezes it in place.
sample.headerRow.name: Style and freeze the header row
sample.highlightDuplicates.description: Shades every value that appears more than once in the selection (or the whole sheet when a single cell is selected).
sample.highlightDuplicates.name: Highlight duplicates
sample.removeBlankRows.description: Deletes every completely empty row inside the data of the active sheet.
sample.removeBlankRows.name: Remove blank rows
sample.sumEachColumn.description: Adds a bold Total row under the data with a SUM for every column that holds numbers.
sample.sumEachColumn.name: Sum each column
sample.tableOfContents.description: Adds a Contents sheet at the front listing every sheet, each name a link to it.
sample.tableOfContents.name: Make a table of contents
sample.unhideEverything.description: Shows every hidden sheet, row and column in the workbook.
sample.unhideEverything.name: Unhide everything
